name: mail-archiver
description: Mail Archiver is a web-based solution for archiving, searching, and exporting emails. All emails and attachments are stored in a Postgresql database. Also supports OpenID Connect (OIDC) for Single Sign On. The documentation contains examples for Authelia and Microsoft Entra ID.

paths.name: Folder for Data Protection Keys
paths.description: Folder for storing data protection keys

variables.name: Database Connection String
variables.description: PostgreSQL connection string. Format: Host=postgres-ip-address;Port=5432;Database=dbname;Username=user;Password=pass; Replace 'postgres' with your PostgreSQL IP address (on bridge network) or container name (on custom network) and update credentials as needed.

variables.name: Admin Username
variables.description: The username for the admin account.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: The password for the admin account.

variables.name: Display Time Zone
variables.description: The time zone used for displaying email timestamps in the UI. Use any TZ identifier from: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones

variables.name: OAuth Enabled
variables.description: Set to true to enable OIDC authentication.

variables.name: OAuth Authority
variables.description: The OIDC authority/issuer URL of your identity provider (e.g. for Authelia: https://auth.example.com/). Note the trailing slash at the end.

variables.name: OAuth Client Id
variables.description: OIDC client ID configured in your identity provider (e.g. Authelia) for Mail Archiver.

variables.name: OAuth Client Secret
variables.description: Client secret for the OIDC client.

variables.name: OAuth Disable Password Login
variables.description: Set to true to disable traditional username/password login and enforce OAuth-only authentication.

variables.name: OAuth Auto Approve Users
variables.description: If set to true, new OIDC users are automatically approved. Enable if you manage your users exclusively in your OIDC provider.

variables.name: OAuth Client Scopes 0
variables.description: Scope #1 as requested from the identity provider.

variables.name: OAuth Client Scopes 1
variables.description: Scope #2 as requested from the identity provider.

variables.name: OAuth Client Scopes 2
variables.description: Scope #3 as requested from the identity provider.

variables.name: Session Timeout (Minutes)
variables.description: The session timeout in minutes.

variables.name: Cookie Name
variables.description: The name of the authentication cookie.

variables.name: Mail Sync Interval (Minutes)
variables.description: The interval in minutes between email synchronization.

variables.name: Mail Sync Timeout (Minutes)
variables.description: The timeout for the sync operation in minutes.

variables.name: Connection Timeout (Seconds)
variables.description: The connection timeout for IMAP connections in seconds.

variables.name: Command Timeout (Seconds)
variables.description: The command timeout for IMAP commands in seconds.

variables.name: Always Force Full Sync
variables.description: Whether to always force a full sync (true/false).

variables.name: Ignore Self-Signed Certificates
variables.description: Whether to ignore self-signed certificates (true/false).

variables.name: Batch Restore Async Threshold
variables.description: The number of emails that triggers async processing.

variables.name: Max Sync Emails
variables.description: The maximum number of emails for sync processing.

variables.name: Max Async Emails
variables.description: The maximum number of emails for async processing.

variables.name: Batch Restore Session Timeout (Minutes)
variables.description: The session timeout for batch restore in minutes.

variables.name: Default Batch Size
variables.description: The default batch size for email operations.

variables.name: Batch Operation Size
variables.description: The batch size for email operations.

variables.name: Pause Between Emails (ms)
variables.description: The pause between individual emails in milliseconds.

variables.name: Pause Between Batches (ms)
variables.description: The pause between batches in milliseconds.

variables.name: Max Selectable Emails
variables.description: The maximum number of emails that can be selected at once.

variables.name: Database Command Timeout
variables.description: The timeout for database commands in seconds.

variables.name: Max Upload File Size (GB)
variables.description: The maximum file size for uploads in GB.

variables.name: Upload Keep Alive Timeout (Hours)
variables.description: The keep alive timeout for uploads in hours.

variables.name: Upload Request Headers Timeout (Hours)
variables.description: The timeout for request headers in hours.
